description: Undo across an over boundary (compound case)
note: Executable, unlike EX-10/EX-11 -- reuses TASK-0029's undoLastDelivery() directly. This is a two-step scenario (apply, then undo), not the single genesis/delivery/expected shape -- see expectedAfterDelivery/expectedAfterUndo. Already covered by InningsFolderTest.kt's ex12_undo_across_an_over_boundary_reverts_everything_together test.

expectedAfterDelivery.note: the over has completed, overNumber has advanced, and (per the narrative) the client is currently showing the bowler-change prompt (UX-15) for the new over

expectedAfterUndo.note: byte-identical to genesis -- legalBallCount reverts to 5 (over not complete), overNumber reverts to the prior over, the bowler-change prompt that had just appeared is automatically retracted, strike reverts to whoever was striker before the six -- all automatic, none separately coded (§18.1)
